Gulf shrimp, crab and grouper straight off the boats — the Destin Seafood Festival runs Sept 25–27 along the harbor boardwalk, about a 35-minute drive west.

Saturday goes 10 AM to 10 PM and closes under fireworks.

Blue Moon is open Sat Sep 26 – Sun 27, two nights, three king bedrooms and a quiet lane to come home to.

Book direct — link in bio.

The Destin Seafood Festival takes over the harbor boardwalk Sept 25–27 — 75+ food, art and retail vendors, five music stages, a Kids Zone, and Saturday closing under fireworks, about a 35-minute drive west of us. Blue Moon is open Sat Sep 26 – Sun 27 (2 nights), with three king bedrooms, a private back patio and the beach walkover three minutes away.
